mcp_config.notes: MCP servers configurable; tool names follow mcp__<server>__<tool> pattern

detection_notes: Presence of CLAUDE.md in repo root or .claude/ folder
discovery_notes: Scans .claude/ folder and ~/.claude/ for skills and settings
Skills also discoverable under .claude/agents/, .claude/commands/, and .claude/rules/*.md conventions observed in v2.1.272 binary strings.
rule_notes: CronCreate durable:true persists jobs to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json; non-durable jobs are in-memory only and die with the session.

tool_calls.name: Task
tool_calls.notes: Spawn sub-agent; supports isolation:worktree|remote (remote always runs in background; gated availability). run_in_background defaults true. New in 2.1.272: 'model' now also accepts 'fable' in addition to sonnet|opus|haiku (ignored for subagent_type:'fork', which always inherits parent model); 'name' (addressable via SendMessage/SendUserMessage), 'team_name' and legacy 'mode' fields are now deprecated/ignored (subagents inherit the parent session's permission mode).

tool_calls.name: Bash
tool_calls.notes: Execute shell command; max timeout 600000ms; supports run_in_background

tool_calls.name: Read
tool_calls.notes: Read file; supports text, image, notebook, pdf types

tool_calls.name: enter_worktree
tool_calls.notes: Enter a git worktree for isolation

tool_calls.name: Skill
tool_calls.notes: Load and execute a named skill (SKILL.md); confirmed present in binary strings for v2.1.272.

tool_calls.name: BashOutput
tool_calls.notes: Deprecated alias resolving to TaskOutput. Prefer Read on the output file path for bash/remote_agent tasks, or the Agent tool result for local_agent tasks.

tool_calls.name: TaskOutput
tool_calls.notes: Read background task output; supports block/timeout params.

tool_calls.name: TaskCreate
tool_calls.notes: Create a tracked task with subject/description/activeForm/metadata.

tool_calls.name: TaskList
tool_calls.notes: List tracked tasks; no input fields.

tool_calls.name: REPL
tool_calls.notes: Execute JavaScript with persistent state across calls; default timeout 30000ms, max 600000ms.

tool_calls.name: Workflow
tool_calls.notes: Run a self-contained workflow script (agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase()); supports resumeFromRunId and scriptPath persistence under .claude/workflows/.

tool_calls.name: CronCreate
tool_calls.notes: Schedule a recurring or one-shot cron job; durable:true persists to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json (auto-expires after 7 days when recurring).

tool_calls.name: CronDelete
tool_calls.notes: Delete a cron job by id.

tool_calls.name: CronList
tool_calls.notes: List cron jobs; no input fields.

tool_calls.name: ScheduleWakeup
tool_calls.notes: Schedule a delayed wakeup (delaySeconds clamped to [60,3600]) driving the dynamic /loop mechanism.

tool_calls.name: ShowOnboardingRolePicker
tool_calls.notes: Show the onboarding role picker UI; no input fields.

tool_calls.name: ReadNotifications
tool_calls.notes: Read pending notifications; no input fields.

tool_calls.name: Monitor
tool_calls.notes: Watch a shell command or WebSocket stream for events; default timeout 300000ms, capped at 1800000ms.

tool_calls.name: ProposeSkills
tool_calls.notes: Propose 1-3 new or improved skills (kebab-case name, description, evidence, full SKILL.md) for user review.

tool_calls.name: ProposeGoal
tool_calls.notes: Propose a verifiable completion condition (<=500 chars) for the session goal; ask_user defaults true.

tool_calls.name: Artifact
tool_calls.notes: Publish/list/read/watch/unwatch/status HTML artifacts and manage their assets (upload_asset/list_assets/read_asset/delete_asset).

tool_calls.name: PushNotification
tool_calls.notes: Send a proactive push notification; message capped under 200 chars (mobile OS truncation).

tool_calls.name: SendFeedback
tool_calls.notes: Structured bug/idea/missing_capability feedback report with failure_mode and task_category taxonomies.

tool_calls.name: ClaudeDesign
tool_calls.notes: Server-validated design operations; call with operation:'list' first to discover available operations.

tool_calls.name: EnterPlanMode
tool_calls.notes: Enter planning mode; no input fields.

tool_calls.name: ReportFindings
tool_calls.notes: Report up to 32 verified code-review findings with file/line/summary/failure_scenario/category/verdict/outcome.

tool_calls.name: RefreshMcpTools
tool_calls.notes: Refresh MCP tool listings for one or all connected servers.

tool_calls.name: ReadMcpResourceDir
tool_calls.notes: List an MCP server's directory resource by URI.

tool_calls.name: SendUserMessage
tool_calls.notes: Send a message to the user or a named addressable sub-agent (SendMessage({to: name})).

manifest_fields.name: agents
manifest_fields.notes: Custom agents' `model` field may list several model IDs (tried in order); `model-policy: required` pins model overrides to that list (v1.0.83).

detection_notes: Presence of AGENTS.md in repo root
discovery_notes: Loads marketplace.json from plugin root for plugin metadata
rule_notes: Homepage and repository must be valid URLs

Breaking (v1.0.80): Agent Plugins spec plugins now read commands/, agents/, rules/, hooks/hooks.json, lsp.json, and extensions/ only under a com.github.copilot/ subdirectory of the plugin root — no longer from the plugin root directly. Extensions were allowed under com.github.copilot/extensions/ starting v1.0.79.
Custom agents can list several models in the `model` manifest field (tried in order until one is available); `model-policy: required` pins model changes to that list (v1.0.83).

tool_calls.name: apply_patch
tool_calls.notes: Apply a unified-diff style patch; category 'edit'.

tool_calls.name: local_shell
tool_calls.notes: Run a local shell command; category 'execute'.

tool_calls.name: read_bash
tool_calls.notes: Read output from a running/completed background bash session; category 'read'.

tool_calls.name: write_bash
tool_calls.notes: Write input to an interactive background bash session; category 'edit'.

tool_calls.name: stop_bash
tool_calls.notes: Stop a running background bash session; category 'execute'.

tool_calls.name: session_store_sql
tool_calls.notes: Run read-only SQL against the cloud/local session store (DuckDB/SQLite).

tool_calls.name: read_agent
tool_calls.notes: Read results/turn history from a background agent.

tool_calls.name: write_agent
tool_calls.notes: Send a follow-up message to a running/idle background agent.

tool_calls.name: ask_user
tool_calls.notes: Ask the user a clarifying question interactively.

tool_calls.name: github-mcp-server-web_search
tool_calls.notes: GitHub-hosted MCP server variant of web_search; category 'search'.

tool_calls.name: search_code_subagent
tool_calls.notes: Delegate a code search to a sub-agent; category 'search'.

tool_calls.name: report_progress
tool_calls.notes: Report progress on a long-running task; category 'think'.

tool_calls.name: ide_selection
tool_calls.notes: Read the current IDE editor selection.

tool_calls.name: noop
tool_calls.notes: Safe-output no-op signal used in gh-aw workflows when no GitHub write action is needed.

hook_events.notes: Confirmed via official HookType enum in schemas/api.schema.json bundled with copilot-cli v1.0.83.

adaptor_fixes: Extend the claude engine tool-name table in crates/libaipm/ to include the newly observed built-in tools (Skill, TaskOutput/TaskCreate/TaskGet/TaskUpdate/TaskList, REPL, Workflow, CronCreate/CronDelete/CronList, ScheduleWakeup, RemoteTrigger, Monitor, ProposeSkills, ProposeGoal, Artifact, PushNotification, SendFeedback, ClaudeDesign, Projects, EnterPlanMode, ReportFindings, RefreshMcpTools, ReadMcpResourceDir, SendUserMessage/Brief, ListAgents/ListPeers) so the valid-tool-name lint rule does not false-positive on plugins targeting recent claude-code versions.
Recognize BashOutput/AgentOutputTool/AgentOutput/KillShell/KillBash as deprecated aliases resolving to TaskOutput/TaskStop respectively, and warn (not error) when a plugin declares them explicitly.
Add .claude/agents/, .claude/commands/, .claude/rules/*.md, .claude/workflows/, .claude/plugins/, and .claude/scheduled_tasks.json to the claude folder/settings detection tables.
test_cases: Plugin declaring tools: [Skill] with no engines restriction should not trigger valid-tool-name warning for claude.
Plugin declaring tools: [BashOutput] should trigger a deprecation notice pointing at TaskOutput.
Detector test: repo containing only .claude/agents/foo.md (no CLAUDE.md) is still detected as claude-oriented.
Migration test: manifest referencing Task's deprecated 'mode'/'team_name' AgentInput fields is flagged as no-op/ignored rather than erroring.
behaviour_variants: Task tool's isolation field now supports 'remote' in addition to 'worktree' — always backgrounded; lint should treat remote isolation as requiring background execution.
Task tool's model override now accepts 'fable' alongside sonnet|opus|haiku; ignored entirely for subagent_type:'fork'.

adaptor_fixes: Update the copilot-cli plugin-layout detector in crates/libaipm/ for the v1.0.80 breaking change: Agent Plugins spec plugins now source commands/, agents/, rules/, hooks/hooks.json, lsp.json, and extensions/ exclusively from a com.github.copilot/ subdirectory of the plugin root instead of the plugin root itself. Existing plugin-root layout support should emit a migration warning rather than silently failing.

Extend the copilot-cli tool-name table with the newly observed built-in tools (view, edit, create, str_replace_editor/str_replace, apply_patch, delete, move, powershell, local_shell, shell, read_bash/write_bash/stop_bash, task, skill, manage_schedule, session_store_sql, read_agent/write_agent/list_agents, ask_user, web_search, github-mcp-server-web_search, search_code_subagent, update_todo, report_progress, fetch_copilot_cli_documentation, ide_diagnostics, ide_selection, noop).
Add ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md, ~/.copilot/instructions/**/*.instructions.md, and .github/hooks/*.json to the copilot folder-convention detection tables.

Add the new HookType values (preMcpToolCall, userPromptTransformed, postResult, prePRDescription, permissionRequest, notification) to the copilot hook validation/lint rule so plugin hooks.json files using them are not rejected as unknown events.
test_cases: Plugin with commands/agents/hooks at the plugin root (pre-v1.0.80 layout) should emit a migration warning directing the author to move them under com.github.copilot/.
Plugin with commands/agents/hooks correctly nested under com.github.copilot/ should validate cleanly against the v1.0.80+ layout.
hooks.json declaring hook type 'preMcpToolCall' should validate without a lint error.
Plugin declaring tools: [noop] alongside engines: [claude] only should trigger a valid-tool-name warning (noop is copilot-cli/gh-aw-exclusive).
Custom agent manifest declaring `model: [gpt-5, gpt-5-mini]` with `model-policy: required` should validate as a legal ordered fallback list.
behaviour_variants: Tool-name collision caveat for valid-tool-name lint: 'task', 'skill', 'edit', and 'monitor' now exist as tool names in both engines' catalogs, but 'monitor' means different things per engine (claude: watch a shell command/WebSocket stream; copilot: Azure Monitor MCP tool) -- do not treat name equality alone as behavioural equivalence when generating cross-engine compatibility warnings for 'monitor'.
Custom agents may declare `model` as an ordered list of model IDs tried in sequence until one is available, gated by `model-policy: required`.
MCP servers contributed by plugins now persist across built-in sub-agent turns and survive MCP server restarts without being dropped.
